name: stats-bold
blurb: Large-text stats display with hero number, descriptive label, and supporting image.
description: Section component showcasing stats with bold, large typography (8xl-9xl). Primary stat (10B+ API Calls) paired with Unsplash image. Secondary stats row below (3 columns) showing P99 latency, regions, and support availability. Hardcoded content.
use_when: Landing pages emphasizing scale and performance with impressive large numbers.
avoid_when: Reusable stats component; data is hardcoded.
a11y: Semantic section and heading elements. Large text sizes (8xl+) provide good visibility. Images include alt text.
